query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') as month,
  COUNT(*) as sales_count,
  SUM(CAST(totalSaleValue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_revenue
FROM sales_transactions
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') IN ('2026-05', '2026-06')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;
